tools.name: houdini_status
tools.description: Start here. Reports the connected Houdini (pid, version, GUI or headless, hip path and dirty state, $HIP/$JOB, frame, recent files, scene_generation), every live instance and the bridge settings. Works with no Houdini running (connected: null).

tools.name: houdini_connect
tools.description: Choose the Houdini this session drives: pid attaches, launch starts one (gui or headless, optional hip), disconnect drops the selection, quit closes it. A launched Houdini usually closes with this server (launched.outlives_server says); `hocuspocus launch` starts one that outlives it.

tools.name: hip_new
tools.description: Clear to a new untitled scene; bumps scene_generation. on_unsaved protects unsaved work: fail returns unsaved_changes, save saves first (an untitled scene needs hip_save with path instead), discard drops the changes.

tools.name: hip_open
tools.description: Load a hip file, replacing the current scene; on_unsaved as in hip_new. Load warnings are returned in warnings, not raised, unless ignore_load_warnings is false. hip_merge adds nodes instead.

tools.name: hip_save
tools.description: Save the hip file. path saves as (creating directories; an untitled scene needs it); increment saves to the next version number in the file name; backup keeps a backup copy. Returns the real saved path, dirty after save, and bytes.

tools.name: hip_merge
tools.description: Merge the nodes matching node_pattern from another hip file into the current scene. dry_run only reports collisions (no undo step, allowed read-only). Colliding nodes are renamed unless overwrite_on_conflict.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Read the scene. what: node, parms, network, outline, geo (rows: true for values; group_by: stats per value), image (Cop), stage (USD), problems, type, events or jobs; target is the node, LOP, Cop or node type. guide (target: topic) and tool (target: name) read the docs, no Houdini needed. Returns an etag and the read, compact: defaults and empties left out.

target.description: Node, parm, LOP, Cop or type path.

parms.description: parms, type: name or label glob.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search node types or nodes. kind types: query is a name, label or keyword (ranked, synonyms; current_only hides older versions). kind nodes: under root, query a type glob; pattern, category, flags, has_errors filter. Compact rows, paged by limit and cursor.

query.description: types: name or keyword; nodes: type glob.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Change the scene in one undo step. ops run in order, each {op, id?, ...}: create, delete, connect, set, node (rename, flags, color, comment, position, lock, spare_parms), copy, layout, build (hou.data), select; later ops name an earlier op's node as $id. dry_run validates, returning resolved paths. A failure rolls all back unless partial. Returns per-node rows (problems only) and ids.

partial.description: Keep what worked; stop: the ops before a failure.

tools.name: node_create
tools.description: Create nodes in one undo step. type resolves like createNode (box gets the current version; exact_type disables). Items may wire to earlier items; a block_end pairs with its block_begin (paired_with). Returns path, type and problems per node. edit suits whole graphs.

parms.description: Parm name to a value or a parm_set item without path.

tools.name: parm_set
tools.description: Set parms in one undo step. Each item takes one of value, expression, keyframe(s), channel_ref, ramp, multiparm_count, revert_to_default, press. Tuple paths take lists, component paths scalars; menus take token or label. animation replace clears keys and expressions first; key keys at frame; keep is plain set. Returns value, raw, wrote_keyframe, node errors.

basis.description: One basis, or one per key.

tools.name: cook
tools.description: Cook nodes and report per node ok, errors, warnings, cook_time_ms. Cooking never writes files (render does). profile force-cooks the inputs a cook uses: chain (top 10), total_ms, attribution; for-each loop bodies show their cost over all iterations (loops). frame_range cooks frame by frame (sims advance); summary bbox adds bbox rows. Past wait_s returns job_id for job.

on.description: Instance to run on: pid, name or role.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Render any ROP (Karma, Flipbook, USD, ...) or writer SOP (File Cache, rop_geometry) for frames [start, end, inc] (default the ROP's own frame range), optionally overriding output. Waits up to wait_s (default the job threshold): if done, returns outputs, a thumbnail and notes; else job_id to poll with job.

on.description: Instance to run on: pid, name or role.

tools.name: look
tools.description: Look at the scene: a PNG (long side at most 1024). target: an object, SOP, LOP, Cop node or ROP (default the display). quality draft is a Flipbook ROP (headless too), lit adds the scene's lights (Karma when there are none), final renders Karma. Returns backend_used, chain, scene, context, camera_used, notes. Leaves no nodes, undo step or dirty flag.

target.description: Object, SOP, LOP, Cop node or ROP path.

output.description: Also save the image to this .png or .jpg file.

on.description: Instance to run on: pid, name or role.

tools.name: houdini_python
tools.description: Run Python (hou bound) or HScript on Houdini's main thread in one undo step, for anything no tool covers. Returns stdout, stderr and result. An uncaught exception fails with python_exception and is rolled back; code still running near timeout_s is stopped (houdini_busy).

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undo or redo steps (default 1) and return the labels performed, or list the last 20 undo labels with history. Every HocusPocus mutation is one step labelled "HocusPocus: <tool> ...".

tools.name: time
tools.description: Read or set playbar time. With no arguments returns frame, fps and range. frame sets the current frame, range [start, end] the frame range, fps the frame rate.

tools.name: job
tools.description: Jobs from render, cook or pdg: status (state, progress, message), result (the tool's result once done), cancel, list.

on.description: Instance to run on: pid, name or role.

tools.name: hda
tools.description: Digital assets: create turns subnet path into an HDA; save writes path's contents and spare parms to its definition; unlock allows editing; match reverts and locks; install, uninstall and reload take library_path; list shows loaded libraries; info describes one definition. interface edits parms as spare_parms does.

tools.name: pdg
tools.description: Drive a TOP node: cook its work items as a job (block waits up to timeout_s, capped at the job threshold), status, workitems (paged; failed items say why), cancel, dirty.

tools.name: events
tools.description: What changed since your last call: hip, node (created, renamed, deleted, parms or flags changed on nodes HocusPocus touched or read) and pdg events with seq and origin (agent|houdini|other). Pass next_since back as since.
